input: Take a foraging walk in local woodland

gold.taskTitle: Take a foraging walk in local woodland
gold.taskDescription: Plan and carry out a foraging walk in a nearby woodland to find and collect wild edible plants, fungi, or other natural resources.

questions.title: Which woodland location do you have in mind?
questions.description: Identify the specific woodland or general area the user plans to visit.

questions.title: What do you want to forage for specifically?
questions.description: Determine the target items such as mushrooms, berries, herbs, nuts, or general wild edibles.

questions.title: What is your current foraging experience level?
questions.description: Understand whether the user is a complete beginner, has some knowledge, or is experienced, to tailor preparation advice.

questions.title: When are you planning to go on this walk?
questions.description: Find out the intended date or timeframe so seasonal availability of forageable items can be considered.

questions.title: Will you be going alone or with other people?
questions.description: Clarify whether this is a solo trip, a group outing, or whether a guided experience is being considered.

questions.title: Do you need to identify safe species before you go?
questions.description: Establish whether the user needs help learning identification of edible versus harmful species in advance.

questions.title: Are there any access or legal permissions needed for that woodland?
questions.description: Determine whether the woodland is public, private, or protected land requiring permits or specific foraging rules.
